highlights:
## 🛠️ Give first setup another try

Linux setup now checks the private computer image before it starts. Its new copy method avoids the image-copy failure on eCryptfs home folders.

New Mac and Linux setups also record their progress before the first start. If that start fails or is stopped, retry can rebuild the unfinished computer. Completed computers keep their data. An older interrupted Mac setup may still need help; send its startup log in feedback.

## 📂 File permission, without a detour

Ask Nod to list Downloads, read an invoice, or save a report. If local file access is off, Nod can now ask to turn it on in chat, save your choice, and continue your request.

This setting covers allowed locations in your home folder and on external drives. Your excluded folders and the checks for each file action still apply. Change the setting in **Settings → Privacy & data**, or ask Nod to turn it off.

## Also in this release

- **Long requests:** Nod checks request size before sending it to a model. Large content stays available in workspace files, with shorter previews in the request.
- **Setup:** A retry after account setup no longer repeats the account save when only the local device check failed.
- **Contacts:** Shared contact previews now read quoted vCard parameters, including values with colons or semicolons.
